results.title: Exile
results.overview: Mohamed, a steelworker shattered by the death of his friend in a tragic accident, lives with a piece of rusted metal lodged in his head. As the rust spreads through his body, he rises against corruption, becoming a symbol of resistance and sacrifice.

results.title: The Spectacle
results.overview: A young Roma boy is lifted into the light, only to find it fades in an unexpected way.

results.title: King of Painting
results.overview: Ke Huan is a talented and dreamy painter, but in this "era of hype by all", he became a joke in Tangzhuang, a painter village, because he was busy painting. Just when he couldn't pay the rent, was bullied by his peers, and his girlfriend was stolen by his rival, an alien changed his fate! With the help of "it"'s superpowers, the protagonist Ke Huan drove a luxury car, lived in a luxury house, held his dream exhibition, became a hot painter, and reached the peak of his life! The arrival of "it" also caused trouble everywhere, shocked the world, and caused panic among the people. The police, opponents, and even aliens came to the door one after another.

results.title: Vyasanasametham Bandhumithradhikal
results.overview: A small-town shopkeeper deals with his daughter's engagement, his mother-in-law's sudden death, and family issues, while his daughter starts to question her marriage and speaks up for herself.

results.title: Simply Red - Home: Live in Sicily
results.original_title: Simply Red - Home: Live in Sicily
results.overview: With a jazzy band featuring brass instruments, Mick Hucknall, the lead singer of Simply Red, performs his hits in the magical setting of the ancient amphitheater in Taormina. Recorded on July 23, 2003, at the ancient theater in Taormina, Sicily.

results.title: DRAWN OUT
results.overview: On the eve of leaving for college, Randy discovers that the childhood drawings she's long forgotten are not quite ready to let her go. When her imaginary friends come to life, they pull her into a surreal final adventure through her own home, one that forces her to confront buried memories, unresolved guilt, and the fear she's been avoiding. As fantasy and reality collide, Randy must decide whether to run from her past or face it head-on, learning that growing up doesn't mean leaving every part of yourself behind.

results.title: Beginnings
results.overview: Ane and Thomas are on the verge of being divorced when Ane suffers a stroke, forcing them to stay together and postpone telling their children about the split. Faced with this new reality, the two find hope where they least expect it.

results.title: Betray: Thirst
results.overview: Jamal Wiggins is a lawyer at Tate and Wiggins, the law firm he co-founded with his college roommate and friend, Darren Tate. While he enjoys professional success, his personal life is strained by a sexless marriage to Shavonne, his wife of 15 years. He takes on a case representing Jada Campbell, whose husband was involved in a life-altering accident. Jada, a victim of verbal and emotional abuse from her husband, develops feelings for Jamal. He, in turn, succumbs to temptation and crosses a professional boundary, soon realizing his world may be on the verge of collapse.

results.title: Lessons in Fire
results.overview: As wildfires rage ever more fiercely across Europe, Finnish and Portuguese firefighters join forces on the front lines. This visually stunning documentary takes viewers into the flames and shows humanity's struggle against nature's most destructive force.

results.title: Pinwydd
results.overview: Anthropomorphic manifestations of the hyperobjects of animal husbandry, millitarisation, forestry plantations and capitalist markets become combating characters in this poetic film. Rooted in the realities of landlordism, climate collapse, and extractivism, the film draws on sci-fi tropes and the Mabinogion myth of Blodeuwedd to rupture the seeming inevitability of capitalism.

results.title: Hayok
results.overview: Grieving the tragic death of his first love, a young man retreats to a secluded cabin in the mountains -- only to find an enigmatic woman hiding there, whose haunting connection to his past forces them both to confront love, guilt and the weight of unspeakable truths.

results.title: Alien Invasion : Rise of the Phoenix
results.original_title: Alien Invasion : Rise of the Phoenix
results.overview: An asteroid shower lands in a remote section of the Grand Canyon and begins to spread mysterious pods. Meanwhile, scientists on a space station that has been hit by the same asteroid shower, discover that a pod has mutated into a creature and is threatening the ship. Now the scientists and a team on Earth must learn to defeat this alien force, fighting fire with fire, fighting stone with stone.

results.title: "HEADBANGER"
results.overview: Directed by William Strobeck.  The video features Kader Sylla, Troy Gipson, Joseph Campos, Zion Effs, Patrick O’Mara, Seven Strong, Vincent Touzery, Jax Effs, Kris Brown, Sean Pablo, Ben Kadow, Mark Gonzales, Aidan Mackey, Caleb Barnett, Rezza Honarvar, Elijah Odom, Beatrice Domond, Joel Meinholz, Rico Abdou, Sully Cormier, Kevin Bradley, Nik Stain, Zack Krull, Matt Finley, Brian Anderson, Rowan Zorilla, Casper Brooker, Taylor Nida, Auguste Bouznad, and Lil Dre.  Filmed by William Strobeck, Johnny Wilson, Alex Greenberg, Omar Massiah, and Dan Lundy.

results.title: Eraserheads: Combo on the Run
results.overview: When Eraserheads formed in 1989, their music swept the country. But the real story behind the group has remain untold. Until now...

results.title: Eldorado
results.overview: From day to night, Otello, a construction worker and former tailor, moves between a sprawling Parisian construction site and a rundown nightclub on the brink of bankruptcy.

results.title: Trancers: The Whole Dethly Affair
results.overview: Get ready for the ultimate "Trancers" experience with this newly re-edited "master cut" of Trancers 4 and Trancers 5, remixed into one mega movie! When the time-travelling TCL chamber goes haywire, perpetually surly supercop Jack Deth accidentally winds up in a deadly alternate dimension in which a new breed of the ghoulish Trancers have assumed complete control.

results.title: Outlaw
results.overview: Portrait of a rebel expat Estonian filmmaker Vladimir Karasjov-Orgusaar.

results.title: Heart of the Wolf
results.overview: Inspired by actual events, the film follows Aquiles, an Amazonian boy abducted by the terrorist group Shining Path. Through his testimony, we witness his journey from victim to fighter and his desperate attempt to escape. A raw and intimate look at indoctrination, violence, and survival, the film reconstructs his struggle for identity and freedom.

results.title: Amazônia Oktoberfesta
results.overview: A Brazilian development project, initiated during the military dictatorship in the 1970s, encouraged the “exploration” of northern Brazil by settlers from Paraná, Santa Catarina, and Rio Grande do Sul. Based on a German-inspired festival held in Sinop, Mato Grosso, where an anonymous, fictional, and suspicious character wanders through forests and plantations, the narrative offers a free-form account of an immigration process that caused, and continues to cause, cultural, environmental, and political changes in a region once inhabited by diverse Indigenous peoples.
